groups.defect: Running search.init before initWatcher in Init leaves a gap where writes made during the index build are neither indexed nor streamed.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same reordering in server.go Init and flag the same event-loss window. Both propose starting the watcher first or replaying from a recorded RV.

groups.defect: Narrowing cacheMu in BuildIndex lets concurrent builds of the same key run in parallel, which collides on the index directory, duplicates work and leaks indexes; separately, TotalDocs reads the cache map without a lock, causing a data race.
groups.rationale: All three report that removing the full-function lock allows duplicate concurrent builds of the same key. s_4cfadd1d also reports the TotalDocs map race, which must be kept in the merged comment.
